hero.headline: A living dock, a smarter sleep
hero.sub: A batch of quality-of-life drops across the dashboard and the launcher — the ones you feel every day rather than the ones that need explaining.

shot.alt: The Sleep Cycle page showing an Alert state with debt, the last consolidation summary, work sessions and starred highlights — with two live agent chips docked in the corner
shot.caption: Sleep Cycle after a consolidation — and, bottom right, the dock keeping two sessions alive.

items.title: Minimized sessions live in a dock
items.text: Send an agent to the corner and it keeps running, keeps reporting — the chip shows its live state, including a goal run's progress. Click it to bring the pane back.

items.title: Sleep stopped duplicating knowledge
items.text: Consolidation reconciles against what already exists instead of appending a second file on the same topic every cycle.

items.title: Delegate straight from the board
items.text: Hand a task to Claude from the card itself — no copying a slug into a terminal to get started.

items.title: Clone from GitHub while onboarding
items.text: A new project can be pulled from a repo inside the setup wizard, instead of being a thing you go and do first.

blocks.title: The board it all hangs off
blocks.body: Tasks, grouped by status and version, with the filters, views and sync state on one row. Everything above lands here: delegation starts from a card, sleep keeps the versions honest, and a docked agent keeps working while you keep planning.

shot.alt: The task board in Kanban view with To Do, In Progress, In Review and Completed columns of task cards carrying version and tag chips
